scenario: A handler injects context at a declared event; injection capability, size limits, and survival across compaction are declared facts, and injected content is attributed to its module.
when: the module runs at session_start and the session later compacts

reasons: injection at session_start succeeds and is attributed to 'policy-context'
after compaction the adapter reports the injected context as not guaranteed present
an attempted binding to pre_tool is rejected as unsupported
must_not: assume injected context survives compaction when the matrix says otherwise
inject unattributed content indistinguishable from user input
exceed declared size limits and let the harness truncate silently
